On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko

Hearing this, Anggi began to improve her behavior and appearance. Anggi's change took her family by surprise. Anggi learned many things about the palace although it was not as easy as imagined.

programme.title: Royal Blood S1 E3
programme.desc: Salah satu asisten rumah tangga mereka, Ningsih, mengatakan kepada Anggi bahwa mungkin yang dipilih adalah Saras karena ia lebih penurut dan lebih “keraton”. Mendengar hal itu, Anggi mulai memperbaiki sikap dan penampilannya. Perubahan Anggi membuat keluarganya terkejut. Anggi pun mempelajari banyak hal tentang kehidupan keraton, meskipun tidak semudah yang dibayangkan.

programme.title: Roy & Marten Sahabat Sehidup Semati S1 E1
programme.desc: This series follows the story of two close friends, Roy (Tanta Ginting) and Marten (Gading Marten). One day, Roy asks Marten to help open his spiritual perception so that he may communicate with the spirit of his deceased father.

programme.title: Roy & Marten Sahabat Sehidup Semati S1 E1
programme.desc: Roy, seorang politisi yang sedang mengalami kesulitan keuangan untuk pencalonannya. Ia bermimpi bertemu dengan almarhum ayahnya yang punya tabungan crypto. Supaya bisa mendapatkan password akun crypto sang ayah, Roy meminta bantuan Marten, sahabatnya yang indigo untuk membuka mata batinnya.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Lintas iNews Siang
programme.desc: A news program that airs every afternoon, conveying the facts as they are, without any manipulation, and presenting the latest and most up-to-date news.

programme.title: Lintas iNews Siang
programme.desc: Program berita yang tayang tiap siang hari, menyampaikan fakta apa adanya, tanpa rekayasa, serta menyajikan berita-berita tekini dan teraktual.

programme.title: Seleb On News
programme.desc: An infotainment program that reports the latest information and rumors about Indonesian celebrities.

programme.title: Seleb On News
programme.desc: Program infotainment yang memberitakan informasi dan rumor terkini seputar selebriti Indonesia.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E1
programme.desc: Hanna, a podcaster who inspires many wives, seems to have a perfect marriage with Pram. Yet suspicions of his affair grow, while Dini and Vino hide Dini’s fake pregnancy as Asri rents her womb for money to save her sick father.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E1
programme.desc: Hanna, seorang podcaster yang menginspirasi banyak istri, tampaknya memiliki pernikahan yang sempurna dengan Pram. Namun kecurigaan tentang perselingkuhan Pram semakin kuat, sementara Dini dan Vino menyembunyikan kehamilan palsu Dini, dan Asri menyewakan rahimnya demi uang untuk menyelamatkan ayahnya yang sakit.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E2
programme.desc: Hanna grows suspicious as Pram hides behind mysterious calls and lies. When he cancels plans with Karin for Hanna, jealousy sparks. Meanwhile, Naomi faces chaos after Niko mimics Daniel’s foul words, leading to a heated clash.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E2
programme.desc: Hanna semakin curiga ketika Pram menyembunyikan diri di balik panggilan misterius dan berbagai kebohongan. Ketika ia membatalkan rencananya dengan Karin demi Hanna, rasa cemburu pun muncul. Sementara itu, Naomi menghadapi kekacauan setelah Niko meniru kata-kata kasar Daniel, yang memicu pertengkaran sengit.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E3
programme.desc: Hanna’s world shatters when she finds a mini skirt in Pram’s car, sparking suspicion of betrayal. As she digs deeper, Daniel’s harshness fueled by work mistakes pushes Naomi into an even darker corner of her marriage.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E3
programme.desc: Dunia Hanna hancur ketika ia menemukan rok mini di mobil Pram, yang memicu kecurigaan akan adanya pengkhianatan. Saat ia mencoba mencari tahu lebih jauh, sikap keras Daniel yang dipicu oleh kesalahan di tempat kerja justru mendorong Naomi semakin terjebak dalam sisi gelap pernikahannya.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E4
programme.desc: Rossa urges Hanna to take a break, but Pram’s constant busyness keeps them apart. Meanwhile, Hanna discovers Dini’s fake pregnancy, while Naomi’s crumbling marriage drives her to leave with Niko despite Daniel’s pursuit.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E4
programme.desc: Rossa menyarankan Hanna untuk mengambil waktu istirahat, tetapi kesibukan Pram yang terus-menerus membuat mereka semakin berjauhan. Sementara itu, Hanna mengetahui kehamilan palsu Dini, sedangkan pernikahan Naomi yang semakin runtuh mendorongnya pergi bersama Niko meskipun Daniel berusaha mengejarnya.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E5
programme.desc: Hanna grows doubtful of Pram’s constant lies about his Bali trip and starts seeking proof. Meanwhile, Dini shelters Asri after she’s evicted, but soon feels her role as wife threatened by Asri’s growing presence at home.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E5
programme.desc: Hanna semakin meragukan kebohongan Pram yang terus-menerus tentang perjalanannya ke Bali dan mulai mencari bukti. Sementara itu, Dini menampung Asri setelah ia diusir dari tempat tinggalnya, namun tak lama kemudian merasa perannya sebagai istri terancam oleh kehadiran Asri yang semakin sering di rumah.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E6
programme.desc: Hanna invites Karin to her podcast, hoping she admits her affair with Pram. Though hesitant, Karin needs CHSI’s promotion for her campus event. Meanwhile, Naomi and Niko try to start fresh, yet Daniel’s shadow still lingers.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E6
programme.desc: Hanna mengundang Karin ke podcast-nya dengan harapan Karin akan mengakui perselingkuhannya dengan Pram. Meskipun ragu, Karin membutuhkan promosi dari CHSI untuk acara kampusnya. Sementara itu, Naomi dan Niko mencoba memulai hidup baru, tetapi bayang-bayang Daniel masih menghantui mereka.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E7
programme.desc: Hanna confronts Pram with proof of his affair. While he promises change, the scandal with Karin goes viral, threatening Hanna’s brand deal. Karin faces online hate, losing her reputation and scholarship, just as Vino’s mother shows up at his house where Asri still hides as Dini’s maid.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E7
programme.desc: Hanna menghadapi Pram dengan bukti perselingkuhannya. Meskipun Pram berjanji akan berubah, skandalnya dengan Karin justru menjadi viral dan mengancam kerja sama merek milik Hanna. Karin pun menghadapi hujatan di dunia maya, kehilangan reputasi dan beasiswanya, tepat ketika ibu Vino datang ke rumahnya, tempat Asri masih bersembunyi sebagai pembantu Dini.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E8
programme.desc: Tensions rise as Hanna faces reporters while Daniel falls back into violence, hurting Naomi and Niko. Naomi flees with her son and seeks divorce. As Asri disappears and Karin storms into CHSI, Hanna plots to protect her name.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E8
programme.desc: Ketegangan meningkat saat Hanna menghadapi para wartawan, sementara Daniel kembali terjerumus dalam kekerasan hingga melukai Naomi dan Niko. Naomi pun melarikan diri bersama putranya dan mengajukan perceraian. Sementara Asri menghilang dan Karin datang mengamuk ke CHSI, Hanna menyusun rencana untuk melindungi namanya.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: In the Season 3 premiere, Nishikata is determined to finally outsmart Takagi during a series of playful encounters involving grip-strength training, summer tans, and the first days of the new semester. However, Takagi always seems one step ahead, turning every challenge into another opportunity to tease him. Beneath their lighthearted rivalry, both begin to show subtle signs that their relationship is becoming more meaningful, blending comedy, romance, and everyday school life.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: After her mother’s death, Jhanak is forced to marry her cousin Arshi’s fiancé, Aniruddh, to escape her stalker, Tejas. programme.title: Sayali

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha mengisahkan kehidupan kelas menengah Sachin dan Sailee saat mereka menghadapi kompleksitas hubungan mereka. programme.title: Jaane Anjaane

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: Nasib tiga sepupu Brar Angad, Garry dan Veer dikaitkan dengan tiga adik Monga Sahiba, Seerat dan keerat. Sahiba adalah anak perempuan kedua keluarga Monga yang rajin dan bebas. Dia seorang artis dan mendapat wang untuk keluarganya dengan menjual seni beliau. Seerat, kakak Monga yang tertua, dimanjakan oleh ibunya, Santosh, kerana kecantikannya. Santosh bermimpi untuk berkahwin dengan Seerat dengan seorang lelaki kaya. Seperti takdirnya, Angad jatuh cinta dengan Seerat. programme.title: Ikut Aku Ke Neraka

programme.title: Healing Jalur King Nassar
programme.desc: Healing Jalur King Nassar, tidak hanya berbagi cerita, tetapi juga diajak menemukan kembali semangat hidup melalui musik, interaksi, permainan, hingga "resep healing" sebelum pulang.

programme.title: Healing Jalur King Nassar
programme.desc: “Healing Jalur King Nassar” is not just about sharing stories; it also invites participants to rediscover their zest for life through music, interaction, games, and even a “healing recipe” before heading home.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: This legendary tale of courage and heroism stars Ivy Ling Po as Mulan, the young woman who joined the army and became a true heroine of the Chinese people.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Kisah legendaris yang bercerita tentang keberanian dan kepahlawanan ini dibintangi oleh Ivy Ling Po yang berperan sebagai Mulan, gadis yang bergabung dengan tentara dan menjadi pahlawan sejati bagi warga Tiongkok.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Chi Ming-sing is a former disciple of a gang run by overlord Yoh Xi-hung. Yoh's disciples hunt Chi relentlessly as he travels on a soul-searching journey. He comes to the aid of a seemingly bumbling man who hardly takes even life-threatening scenes seriously.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang pasukan tentara yang pergi untuk menghancurkan geng Hsien Lung, yang merupakan kelompok revolusioner anti-Yuan. Pemimpin mereka Ru Yi Tu melawan Fu Zhong Yuan, penerus kelompok Hsien Lung.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: The third installment of The Brave Archer series brings Guo Jing and Huang Rong closer together as they struggle to find a cure for the Iron Palm Clan's deadly blows.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu plays the son of a police chief, who falls for a sexy dancing girl and gambles for cash. When the girl is raped he swears to defy his father and seek revenge!

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu berperan sebagai putra seorang kepala polisi, yang jatuh cinta pada seorang penari nan seksi. Saat sang gadis diperkosa, ia bersumpah untuk menentang ayahnya dan membalas dendam!

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Peng fought against many swordsmen and won, so he couldn't accept his first defeat and wanted to suicide. The Sect leader gives him the 'Full Moon Scimitar' on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Peng si ahli pedang selalu menang melawan para pendekar, hingga ia kalah untuk pertama kalinya dan ingin bunuh diri. Pemimpin Sekte memberinya 'Pedang Bulan Purnama' dengan syarat ia tidak boleh keluar dari sekte.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Berlatar pada malam penyerbuan Jepang di Hong Kong, film tentang kisah cinta yang tragis produksi Shaw Brothers ini dibintangi oleh Li Ting dan Kwan Shan sebagai sepasang kekasih yang terpisahkan oleh perang.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim of being impervious to knives and guns. She decides to use them to chase the foreigners from China.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: Ibu Suri Cixi mempercayai pernyataan kelompok pemberontak penjajahan jika mereka kebal terhadap pisau dan senjata. Ia pun memutuskan untuk memanfaatkan mereka untuk mengusir penjajah asing dari Tiongkok.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Two guys and their women constantly get harassed by a group of young motorcycle outlaws on a small island. The situation becomes deadly when one of them gets killed.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions Of A...
programme.desc: A poor girl sold into prostitution soon becomes the focus of a detective's investigation when a series of murders occur at the brothel where she works.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions Of A...
programme.desc: Seorang gadis miskin yang dijual ke prostitusi segera menjadi fokus penyelidikan seorang detektif ketika serangkaian pembunuhan terjadi di rumah bordil tempat dia bekerja.

programme.title: Legend Of The Bat
programme.desc: Charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Hsiang, whose battlefield exploits rival his bedroom antics, travels to the Island of Bats, where he encounters monks, women and plenty of action!

programme.title: Legend Of The Bat
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang karismatik, Chu Liu Hsiang pergi ke Pulau Kelelawar. Di sana ia bertemu dengan para biksu, wanita serta berbagai aksi petualangan!

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: Dalam Sex, Love, And Hate, Chu Yuan menggabungkan bintang dari genre film kungfu dan film dewasa untuk mengangkat perbedaan pandangan masyarakat Hong Kong tentang cinta dan apa yang diinginkan wanita dari cinta.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: A gang of ex-military guys are hired by a mysterious dame who wants them to go into Cambodia and kidnap the assassin who killed her father.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Three young kung-fu warriors from wildly different backgrounds: Royal Guard Lo Lieh, fleeing soldier Lo Meng, and villager Wang Yu become students of Shaolin at the same temple.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Three young kung-fu warriors from wildly different backgrounds: Royal Guard Lo Lieh, fleeing soldier Lo Meng, and villager Wang Yu become students of Shaolin at the same temple.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Tiga pendekar kung fu dari latar belakang yang sangat berbeda menjadi murid Shaolin di kuil yang sama: Lo Lieh sang Pengawal Kerajaan, Lo Meng sang tentara yang melarikan diri, dan Wang Yu si pria desa.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Tiga pendekar kung fu dari latar belakang yang sangat berbeda menjadi murid Shaolin di kuil yang sama: Lo Lieh sang Pengawal Kerajaan, Lo Meng sang tentara yang melarikan diri, dan Wang Yu si pria desa.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Roving swordsman Tu Meng-Fei chances to rescue a female pupil Mu Wan-Erh and later, another girl Li Sai-Nan from underworld leader Leng Tien-Lei. Li wants to take vengeance on Leng who murdered her parents.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Tu Meng-Fei menyelamatkan seorang murid wanita, Mu Wan-Erh, dan gadis lainnya, Li Sai-Nan, dari pemimpin dunia kriminal Leng Tien-Lei. Li ingin membalas dendam pada Leng yang membunuh orangtuanya.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang dan putri Jin yang bernama Peony sudah bertunangan sejak lahir, tetapi Jin menolak pertunangan tersebut. Kemudian, Zhang bertemu dengan sesosok roh yang terlihat persis seperti Peony dan mereka jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Cat Vs Rat

programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, yang pernah menjadi juara dunia tinju, melarikan diri ke Makau dari rentenir dan secara tak terduga bertemu Qi, seorang pemuda yang bertekad memenangkan pertandingan tinju.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Satpam Lee Go ditugaskan untuk menjaga sebuah rumah saat pemiliknya pergi. Namun, serangkaian kesalahpahaman lucu terjadi.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: Kisah ini berlatar di Shanghai pada akhir masa Dinasti Qing, dan bercerita tentang seorang pemuda bernama Chen Zhen yang menjadi seorang pahlawan nasional usai menanggung kesulitan dan mengatasi tantangan dalam hidup.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Seorang badut secara tidak sengaja direkrut oleh seorang pemimpin sekte untuk memata-matai seorang kaisar Tiongkok yang muda dan tidak berpengalaman. Segalanya tidak berjalan sesuai rencana, dan dia akhirnya bekerja untuk beberapa pihak yang saling bertentangan sambil berusaha bertahan hidup di tengah kegilaan tersebut.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: A rich old man and a sexy young photographer compete for a stunning young gym instructor. The younger man is clearly winning until the rich man offers a deal.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley diberi kemampuan untuk menahan godaan dari lawan jenis namun hal itu menjadi beban ketika ia hendak menikahi kekasihnya.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Centering on Ip Man's migration to Hong Kong in 1949 as he attempts to propagate his discipline of Wing Chun martial arts.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Berfokus pada migrasi Ip Man ke Hong Kong pada tahun 1949 saat ia berupaya menyebarkan disiplin ilmu bela diri Wing Chun yang dianutnya.

programme.desc: Explore Chengdu, a city where ancient traditions blend with modern life. From giant pandas and flavorful Sichuan cuisine to historic landmarks and vibrant streets, this documentary captures the charm, culture, and relaxed lifestyle of southwest China.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Jelajahi Chengdu, kota yang memadukan tradisi kuno dengan kehidupan modern. Mulai dari panda raksasa, kuliner Sichuan yang kaya cita rasa, hingga situs bersejarah dan jalanan yang semarak, dokumenter ini menampilkan pesona budaya Tiongkok barat daya.

programme.title: Grottoes Of China, Ep 3
programme.desc: a program offering a brief overview of Chinese history, and as a testament to the developments that have taken place over the past 50 years, particularly in China—the major changes that have occurred there as society has transitioned from a traditional way of life to a modern one.

programme.title: Grottoes Of China, Ep 3
programme.desc: program dari sekilas sejarah China, dan sebagai saksi perkembangan yang telah terjadi selama 50 tahun terakhir khususnya di China, perubahan besar yang terjadi di China dari gaya hidup masyarakat tradisional ke masyarakat modern.

programme.title: Land So Rich In Beauty, Ep 4
programme.desc: A story about targeted poverty alleviation in Wanmixi village follows a second-generation poverty alleviation officer and an urban reporter from the big city who overcome numerous difficulties in their efforts to lead the villagers out of poverty. The per capita arable land in Wanmixi Village is very small. Resources are scarcely coupled with transportation difficulties. For hundreds of years, people haven't been able to escape poverty. In 2015, a young man by the name of Pu Quansheng arrives at the village. He is well-versed in the Miao and Tujia dialects and gradually makes changes to improve the situation at Wanximi Village. However, idealism may be beautiful but difficult to implement and the process is full of challenges. Under the guidance of the party, Pu Quansheng enforces new policies and resolutely looks into village cadres who favor their own relatives and friends. In punishing laziness, he also seeks to encourage others to fight for their own dignity and to bring out their spirit of self-reliance.

programme.title: Land So Rich In Beauty, Ep 5
programme.desc: A story about targeted poverty alleviation in Wanmixi village follows a second-generation poverty alleviation officer and an urban reporter from the big city who overcome numerous difficulties in their efforts to lead the villagers out of poverty. The per capita arable land in Wanmixi Village is very small. Resources are scarcely coupled with transportation difficulties. For hundreds of years, people haven't been able to escape poverty. In 2015, a young man by the name of Pu Quansheng arrives at the village. He is well-versed in the Miao and Tujia dialects and gradually makes changes to improve the situation at Wanximi Village. However, idealism may be beautiful but difficult to implement and the process is full of challenges. Under the guidance of the party, Pu Quansheng enforces new policies and resolutely looks into village cadres who favor their own relatives and friends. In punishing laziness, he also seeks to encourage others to fight for their own dignity and to bring out their spirit of self-reliance.

programme.title: Greener Grass

programme.title: Human Traces
programme.desc: Working to restore the ecosystem of an isolated Sub-Antarctic island, Glenn and Sarah live far removed from civilization until the arrival of an enigmatic young man disrupts their quiet existence. As communication with the outside world is cut off, hidden truths, mistrust, and emotional tensions surface, turning the research station into a place of uncertainty and psychological conflict. Set against the stark beauty of New Zealand's remote landscapes, Human Traces is an atmospheric thriller exploring isolation, guilt, and the complexities of human nature.

programme.title: Human Traces
programme.desc: Glenn dan Sarah menjalani kehidupan terpencil di sebuah stasiun penelitian di pulau Sub-Antarktika sambil berupaya memulihkan ekosistem setempat. Ketenangan mereka berubah ketika seorang pemuda misterius datang dan memicu munculnya berbagai rahasia yang selama ini tersembunyi. Saat hubungan dengan dunia luar terputus, rasa curiga, konflik batin, dan ketegangan antarmanusia semakin memuncak. programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: The Hero shines a spotlight on everyday heroes whose compassion and determination create meaningful change in the lives of others. Each episode follows inspiring individuals and communities as they overcome challenges through kindness, courage, and unwavering dedication, whether by supporting those in need, rescuing animals, or protecting the natural environment. Through authentic stories, the series reminds viewers that even the simplest act of goodness can inspire lasting positive change.

programme.title: The Hero

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Twenty fights into his professional career, highly touted Olympic Gold Medalist Lennox Lewis was taking the steps towards claiming his first World Championship. He had knocked out nearly all of his opponents to this point, and a showdown with nemesis "Razor" Ruddock was just a few months away.

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Dua puluh laga dalam karier profesionalnya, peraih medali emas Olimpiade Lennox Lewis mengambil langkah untuk merebut gelar Kejuaraan Dunia pertamanya. Ia telah mencetak KO atas hampir semua lawannya sampai saat ini, dan pertarungan melawan musuh bebuyutannya, "Razor" Ruddock, tinggal beberapa bulan lagi.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Alvarez Vs Cintron
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Canelo Alvarez taking on Kermit Cintron in a bout that helped elevate Alvarez into the light middleweight title picture and take another step towards becoming one of the biggest names in boxing. Also on the card, action from a classic battle between Joel Casamayor and Michael Katsidis for the WBO Lightweight title.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Alvarez Vs Cintron
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah Canelo Alvarez melawan Kermit Cintron dalam pertarungan yang telah membantu mengangkat Alvarez ke dalam perebutan gelar juara kelas menengah ringan dan mengambil satu langkah lagi untuk menjadi salah satu nama terbesar dalam dunia tinju. Juga ada dalam kartu pertandingan, aksi dari pertarungan klasik antara Joel Casamayor dan Michael Katsidis untuk memperebutkan gelar WBO Lightweight.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 24
programme.desc: After a devastating flood disrupted last season's excavation, Rick and Marty Lagina reunite with the Fellowship of the Dig to continue their decades-long search for Oak Island's legendary treasure. Armed with cutting-edge drilling technology, ground-penetrating surveys, and fresh archaeological evidence, the team investigates newly discovered shafts, underground voids, and intriguing artifacts that could finally lead them to the elusive Money Pit. As each discovery raises new questions, Season 12 brings the Fellowship closer than ever to uncovering one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 24
programme.desc: Setelah banjir besar menghambat penggalian pada musim sebelumnya, Rick dan Marty Lagina bersama Fellowship of the Dig kembali melanjutkan pencarian harta karun legendaris Oak Island yang telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun. Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. Di tengah setiap penemuan yang memunculkan teka-teki baru, musim ini menghadirkan harapan terbesar bagi tim untuk semakin dekat mengungkap salah satu misteri harta karun paling terkenal di dunia.

programme.desc: From the enigmatic decline of the Inca Empire and the engineering marvel of Machu Picchu to the possibility of Viking voyages deep into North America and controversial theories surrounding Indonesia's Gunung Padang, this episode investigates the enduring mysteries of history's greatest kingdoms. Through archaeological discoveries, historical evidence, and expert insights, William Shatner examines what these remarkable civilizations reveal about humanity's forgotten past.

programme.title: The UnXplained S8, Ep 6
programme.desc: William Shatner menelusuri berbagai misteri di balik bangkit dan runtuhnya kerajaan-kerajaan besar dunia. Mulai dari penyebab kemunduran Kekaisaran Inca dan keajaiban Machu Picchu, dugaan pelayaran bangsa Viking hingga ke Amerika Utara, hingga teori mengenai situs Gunung Padang di Indonesia yang memicu perdebatan di kalangan arkeolog. Dengan memadukan temuan arkeologi, bukti sejarah, dan pendapat para ahli, episode ini mengungkap bagaimana warisan peradaban kuno masih menyimpan banyak teka-teki yang belum terpecahkan.

programme.title: The Hand That Robbed..., Ep 1
programme.desc: The Hand That Robbed the Cradle revisits the remarkable true story of Delimar Vera, who disappeared as an infant after a suspicious house fire in 1997. Through interviews, archival footage, and investigative reporting, the three-part documentary uncovers the twists and turns that led to the discovery that Delimar was alive years later, exposing deception, resilience, and a family's relentless search for the truth.

programme.title: The Hand That Robbed..., Ep 1

Tasked with reinventing classic game-day favorites, each contestant must infuse their dish with the unique flavors and culinary identity of their represented region. As judges Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich, and Tiffany Derry evaluate creativity, execution, and authenticity, only the strongest performances will advance in the Global Gauntlet.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: World Cup
programme.desc: Persaingan semakin sengit ketika para peserta yang tersisa menghadapi tantangan memasak bertema Piala Dunia dalam suasana pesta barbeku. Mereka ditantang mengolah hidangan khas hari pertandingan menjadi sajian yang lebih kreatif dengan tetap menampilkan identitas kuliner dari wilayah yang mereka wakili. Kreativitas, teknik memasak, dan kemampuan mengangkat cita rasa khas menjadi penentu di hadapan Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich, dan Tiffany Derry, saat para kontestan berusaha mempertahankan tempat mereka di ajang Global Gauntlet.

programme.desc: Liburan Kiki dan teman-temannya berubah menjadi teror setelah bermain jelangkung. Arwah Yanti mengikuti mereka, memicu kerasukan dan mengungkap misteri kematian tragis yang belum terbalaskan.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: After loses his wife, due to childbirth, Fahmi left to raise his eldest son alone. So, he decides to bring his wife back to life through the means of black magic, by hammering a nail into her skull.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Fahmi membesarkan putranya seorang diri setelah istrinya tewas usai melahirkan. Ia pun memutuskan untuk menghidupkan kembali istrinya menggunakan ilmu hitam, yaitu dengan menancapkan paku ke tengkorak sang istri.

programme.title: Kawin Kontrak
programme.desc: Three teens chase what they believe is the fastest way to explore desire, leading them to a village where unexpected twists await. What starts as a reckless plan soon turns into a hilarious journey of love and self-discovery.

programme.title: Kawin Kontrak
programme.desc: Tiga remaja mencari cara instan untuk memenuhi obsesi mereka hingga membawa langkah ke sebuah desa penuh kejutan. Dari rencana nekat lahirlah kisah kocak yang justru mengarahkan mereka pada cinta dan jati diri.

programme.title: Ateng Kaya Mendadak
programme.desc: Farm workers, Ateng and Iskak, have won a lottery that makes them millionaires overnight. They desert their village for Jakarta and meet Vivi, the daughter of a hotel CEO, Eddy Sud.

programme.title: Ateng Kaya Mendadak
programme.desc: Dua petani bernama Ateng dan Iskak memenangkan sebuah undian yang membuat mereka menjadi jutawan dalam sekejap. Keduanya pun pergi ke Jakarta dan bertemu dengan Vivi, putri seorang CEO hotel bernama Eddy Sud.

programme.title: Rumah Hantu Pasar Malam
programme.desc: A new night market mysterious pops up in a small village and, one by one, patrons begin disappearing. This doesn't dissuade five young friends from deciding to hold a birthday party there.

programme.title: Melodi Cinta Rhoma Irama
programme.desc: Rhoma falls in love with Ricca and plan a wedding. However, their love is interrupted by Herman, who also loves Ricca and wants to control Ricca's father's property.

programme.title: Melodi Cinta Rhoma Irama
programme.desc: Rhoma jatuh cinta pada Ricca dan mereka telah merencanakan sebuah pernikahan. Namun, hubungan asmara mereka diusik oleh Herman, pria yang mencintai Ricca dan ingin menguasai harta ayah Ricca.

programme.title: Senggol-Senggolan
programme.desc: Elvi and Adi who are orphans go to Jakarta to find Johny, a show promoter who once asked Elvi to sing in his village. Once there, they got separated.

programme.title: Senggol-Senggolan
programme.desc: Elvi and Adi who are orphans go to Jakarta to find Johny, a show promoter who once asked Elvi to sing in his village. Once there, they got separated.

programme.title: Lorong
programme.desc: Tells about the oddities of a hospital where Mayang gave birth. The mystery that happened to Mayang and Reza is related to the whereabouts of their baby.

programme.title: Lorong
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan tentang sejumlah kejanggalan di rumah sakit tempat Mayang melahirkan yang menyimpan misteri terkait keberadaan buah hati Mayang dan Reza.

programme.title: Tumbal 97
programme.desc: The death of famous artist Saeful Djamil's wife, draws Prista's attention. At the time of taking pictures at the scene of the accident, Prista startles when she sees a shadow of an old blond granny on her pictures.

programme.title: Jamila Dan Sang Presiden
programme.desc: Jamila, a convicted murderer of a government official, refuses to file for clemency. She finds her life in turnmoil after facing the relentless pressure and the conflicts with the president and prison guard.

programme.title: Jamila Dan Sang Presiden
programme.desc: Jamila, terdakwa kasus pembunuhan seorang pejabat, menolak mengajukan grasi kepada presiden. Konflik dengan sang presiden, percekcokan dengan sipir penjara, dan tekanan pihak lain semakin membuat Jamila terpuruk.

programme.title: Suami-Suami Takut Istri
programme.desc: The Griya Mintari wives travel to Bali with their husbands to watch the Trio Ganas' performance. Funny things start to take place as the husbands try to sneak their way to date the singers.

programme.title: Suami-Suami Takut Istri
programme.desc: Para istri di Griya Mintari beserta suami mereka berwisata ke Bali untuk menghadiri pertunjukan Trio Ganas. Berbagai peristiwa lucu pun terjadi saat para suami mencari akal agar dapat berkencan dengan para penyanyi.

programme.title: Dunia Mereka
programme.desc: For Filly, the guitar substitutes for her mother who was killed in a plane crash. Her talent and taste in music makes her joined the band Capung Biru and met Ivan Bramono.

programme.title: 48 Jam Untuk Indah
programme.desc: The story of a middle class man about how he will save his daughter from her sudden illness.

programme.title: 48 Jam Untuk Indah
programme.desc: Kisah tentang seorang pria kelas menengah tentang bagaimana dia akan menyelamatkan putrinya dari penyakitnya yang tiba-tiba.

programme.title: Mertua Vs Menantu
programme.desc: Bianca chose to live the rest of her life by marrying a man named Risyad. However, their happiness in marriage cannot guarantee the harmony of Bianca's relationship with her own mother-in-law, Mrs. Hany.

programme.title: Mertua Vs Menantu
programme.desc: Bianca memilih untuk menjalani sisa hidupnya dengan menikahi seorang pria bernama Risyad. Akan tetapi, kebahagiaan mereka dalam berumah tangga tidak dapat menjamin keharmonisan hubungan Bianca dengan mertuanya sendiri, Ibu Hany.

programme.title: Kuntilanak 3
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers enters a sinister jungle to search for their missing friends. Their path crosses with a mysterious woman on her own quest to reach a mystical village, hoping to break a dark curse that threatens her fate.

programme.title: Kuntilanak 3
programme.desc: Sekelompok anak muda menjelajahi hutan angker untuk mencari teman-teman mereka yang hilang. Di tengah perjalanan, mereka bertemu seorang wanita misterius yang menuju desa mistis demi menemukan cara menghentikan kutukan kelam yang menjeratnya.

programme.title: Bing Slamet Dukun Palsu (IMC)
programme.desc: A criminal on the lam takes on a new identity as a shaman, which causes all kinds of problems when various people come to him looking for help.

programme.title: Bing Slamet Dukun Palsu (IMC)
programme.desc: Seorang buronan kriminal mengambil identitas baru sebagai seorang dukun, yang menyebabkan berbagai macam masalah ketika berbagai orang datang kepadanya untuk meminta pertolongan.

programme.title: Pesan Dari Surga (IMC)
programme.desc: Five young people form a band named ''Topeng''. A problem rises and threats the band's existence. Yet, an accident survivor wakes up from a coma and brings a message from heaven.

programme.title: Pesan Dari Surga (IMC)
programme.desc: Lima pemuda bergabung dalam grup band bernama Topeng. Suatu saat, terjadi masalah besar dan band ini terancam bubar. Namun, seorang korban kecelakaan yang tersadar dari koma datang dan membawa pesan dari surga.

programme.title: Three Queens
programme.desc: The story centers on a struggling daycare worker, his escort boyfriend, and a scrappy older widow living together. As they navigate life’s challenges, relationships, and personal crises, they support each other through financial and emotional ups and downs with humor and heart.

programme.title: Three Queens
programme.desc: Cerita mengikuti seorang pekerja penitipan anak yang kesulitan secara finansial, pasangan kekasihnya yang bekerja sebagai escort, dan seorang janda lansia yang tangguh yang tinggal bersama mereka. Ketiganya saling mendukung menghadapi tantangan hidup, hubungan, dan berbagai krisis eksistensial sambil mencoba tetap bertahan secara ekonomi dan emosional dalam situasi yang sering kocak dan menyentuh hati.

programme.title: My Health My Choice
programme.desc: Each episode features practical health tips, expert medical insights, and inspiring stories about staying fit. The show emphasizes that maintaining good health is a vital choice for everyday life.

programme.title: My Health My Choice
programme.desc: Setiap episode menghadirkan tips kesehatan praktis, penjelasan dari ahli medis, serta kisah inspiratif dalam menjaga tubuh tetap bugar. Program ini membantu pemirsa memahami bahwa menjaga kesehatan adalah keputusan penting dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Be Together
programme.desc: Four friends, Xia Yan, Han Shuang, Zhao Xiao Lei, and Xiang Nan, face love, career, and family challenges. Together, they overcome setbacks, chase their dreams, and discover the true meaning of friendship and happiness.

programme.title: Be Together
programme.desc: Empat sahabat, Xia Yan, Han Shuang, Zhao Xiao Lei, dan Xiang Nan, menghadapi lika-liku cinta, karier, dan keluarga. Bersama, mereka bangkit dari kegagalan, mengejar impian, serta menemukan arti persahabatan dan kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Muslimpedia

programme.title: Galeri Publik Tiens
programme.desc: How did a TIENS Top Leader build a path to success and become an inspiration to so many people? Discover the stories, experiences, challenges, and strategies that led to his extraordinary achievements.

programme.title: Galeri Publik Tiens
programme.desc: Bagaimana perjalanan seorang Top Leader TIENS membangun kesuksesan hingga menjadi inspirasi bagi banyak orang? Temukan cerita, pengalaman, tantangan, dan strategi yang mengantarkannya menuju pencapaian luar biasa.

programme.title: Douluo Continent
programme.desc: Having lost his mother at a very young age, Tang San grew up relying on his father just as much as his father relied upon him. Meticulous and mature for his age, with extraordinary talent and wit, he was sent to Nuoding Academy at the age of sixteen to begin pursuing his dream of becoming a great soul master.

programme.title: Douluo Continent
programme.desc: Setelah kehilangan ibunya sejak usia yang sangat muda, Tang San tumbuh besar dengan saling bergantung pada ayahnya, sebagaimana ayahnya juga bergantung padanya. Bersikap teliti dan dewasa melebihi usianya, dengan bakat serta kecerdikan yang luar biasa, ia dikirim ke Akademi Nuoding pada usia enam belas tahun untuk mulai mengejar mimpinya menjadi seorang master roh yang hebat.

programme.title: Petualangan Upin & Ipin
programme.desc: A children's animated TV show about Upin and Ipin, five-year-old twin brothers who live with their older sister, Kak Ros, and their grandmother, lovingly called Opa, in the village of Kampung Durian Runtuh.

programme.title: Petualangan Upin & Ipin
programme.desc: Serial televisi animasi kartun anak-anak yang mengisahkan kehidupan Upin & Ipin, sepasang anak laki-laki kembar berusia 5 tahun yang tinggal bersama kakaknya bernama Kak Ros dan neneknya yang biasa dipanggil Opa di Kampung Durian Runtuh.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Ayah Mila mengelola satu-satunya toko hewan peliharaan ajaib di kota ini - tempat yang fantastis di mana Anda bisa menemukan berbagai macam hewan peliharaan yang lucu dan unik, yang masing-masing memiliki kekuatan sihir yang unik, dan dia telah menghadiahkan hewan peliharaan paling ajaib untuk Mila, yaitu Morphle.

He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO TREASURE ISLAND ADVENTURE)
programme.desc: Pororo’s great adventure on Treasure Island! To become true pirates, Pororo and his friends must uncover the mystery of an ancient map and face unexpected challenges in the middle of the sea. Follow the excitement only on Mentari TV!

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO TREASURE ISLAND ADVENTURE)
programme.desc: PETUALANGAN HEBAT PORORO DI PULAU HARTA KARUN! DEMI MENJADI BAJAK LAUT SEJATI, PORORO DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA HARUS MENGUNGKAP MISTERI PETA KUNO DAN MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN TAK TERDUGA DI TENGAH LAUT. IKUTI KESERUANNYA HANYA DI MENTARITV!

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: Liko and Roy's adventure reaches a whole new level! Joined by their new friend Ult and Roy's Lucario, which can Mega Evolve, they reunite with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Together, the heroes set out to investigate the mystery behind a strange pink mist that is affecting Pokémon across different regions.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: PETUALANGAN LIKO DAN ROY BERLANJUT KE LEVEL BARU! BERSAMA TEMAN BARU BERNAMA ULT DAN LUCARIO MILIK ROY YANG BISA MEGA EVOLUSI, MEREKA BERSATU KEMBALI DALAM RISING VOLT TACKLERS. KINI, PAHLAWAN KITA HARUS MENYELIDIKI MISTERI KABUT MERAH MUDA ANEH YANG MEMENGARUHI POKÉMON DI BERBAGAI WILAYAH

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Watch music videos for Pororo, Tayo, and their friends!

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Tonton video musik untuk pororo, tayo, dan teman-temannya!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (MUSUH TAK TERDUGA SHUKE & BEITA!)
programme.desc: In a quiet little town, two mouse heroes Shuke, the brave and clever pilot, and Beita, the easy going yet loyal tankist are taken by surprise when an unexpected enemy emerges, hidden beneath the calm of their world.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (MUSUH TAK TERDUGA SHUKE & BEITA!)
programme.desc: Pada suatu hari yang tenang di kota kecil, dua tikus-pahlawan: Shuke—pilot pemberani yang cerdas—dan Beita—tanki sumbu api yang santai namun setia—terkejut ketika muncul sosok musuh tak terduga yang selama ini tersembunyi di balik damainya kehidupan mereka.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: Liko and Roy's adventure reaches a whole new level! Joined by their new friend Ult and Roy's Lucario, which can Mega Evolve, they reunite with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Together, the heroes set out to investigate the mystery behind a strange pink mist that is affecting Pokémon across different regions.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: PETUALANGAN LIKO DAN ROY BERLANJUT KE LEVEL BARU! BERSAMA TEMAN BARU BERNAMA ULT DAN LUCARIO MILIK ROY YANG BISA MEGA EVOLUSI, MEREKA BERSATU KEMBALI DALAM RISING VOLT TACKLERS. KINI, PAHLAWAN KITA HARUS MENYELIDIKI MISTERI KABUT MERAH MUDA ANEH YANG MEMENGARUHI POKÉMON DI BERBAGAI WILAYAH

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Watch the excitement of Momo, Cici, Blu, and the gang. Accompanying your growth and development, Indonesia's golden generation for the world!

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Saksikan keseruan momo, cici, blu dan geng. menemani tumbuh kembangmu, generasi emas indonesia untuk dunia!

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES is a Russian animated series that follows the adventures of the Fixies, tiny creatures who live inside electronic devices. They secretly repair everyday technological problems while teaching viewers about science and technology in a fun and engaging way. The series is designed to help children learn about electronic devices and the importance of properly maintaining them.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES ADALAH SERIAL ANIMASI RUSIA YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN PARA "FIXIES," MAKHLUK KECIL YANG HIDUP DI DALAM PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK. MEREKA MEMPERBAIKI MASALAH TEKNOLOGI SEHARI-HARI SAMBIL MENGAJARKAN PENONTON TENTANG SAINS DAN TEKNOLOGI SECARA MENYENANGKAN. SERIAL INI DIRANCANG UNTUK ANAK-ANAK UNTUK BELAJAR TENTANG PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK DAN PENTINGNYA PERAWATANNYA.

programme.title: Metro TV
programme.desc: The first news television station in Indonesia that broadcasts news and information to all corners of Indonesia, as well as airing a variety of informational programs on technological advances, health, general knowledge, arts and culture, and other topics to educate the nation.

programme.title: Metro TV
programme.desc: Televisi berita pertama di Indonesia yang menyebarkan berita dan informasi ke seluruh pelosok Indonesia, serta menayangkan beragam program informasi mengenai kemajuan teknologi, kesehatan, pengetahuan umum, seni dan budaya, dan lainnya guna mencerdaskan bangsa.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko

Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.
